rubric.3: directly actionable for the requested task

judgment_notes: Judgments list acceptable records; several records can satisfy the same need, so no single ID is required.
A returned record that is not judged here is reported as unjudged; it is never silently scored as relevant.
Grades are evaluator judgments by the same agent that built the benchmark; this is not an independent evaluation.
Constraint conflicts are recorded independently of relevance; provenance and licence fields are reported from the output independently of both.
Historical judgments come from the retained pilot assessments. Synthetic judgments were assigned from catalog record inspection before any synthetic query was executed.

mobile_first_direction.reason: Recommends a mobile-first design direction, contradicting an explicitly desktop-first request

mobile_specific_direction.reason: Visual direction written for mobile apps, contradicting a desktop-focused interface

replacement_identity.reason: Proposes a replacement visual identity (theme, style, design system, palette or typography) where the request requires preserving the existing identity

dark_ground.reason: Dark-ground visual direction where dark mode is explicitly excluded
dark_ground.text_regex: (?i)\bdark\b|midnight|near-black ground|graphite ground|black paper|violet-black ground|coffee-ground black|deep void

glassmorphism.reason: Glass or translucency direction where glassmorphism is explicitly excluded

decorative_motion_preset.reason: Motion preset where decorative animation is explicitly excluded

motion_led_direction.reason: Motion-led visual direction where decorative animation is explicitly excluded
